name: Lynx Ladder
tagline: Climb the ranked ladder without the copium.
positioning: Personalized esports coaching that turns your VOD reviews, aim drills, and tilt spirals into an actual plan for climbing.

hero.h1: Get good. On purpose, this time.
hero.sub: Lynx Ladder pairs you with a coach who watches your worst deaths so you don't have to relive them alone. Real VOD reviews, real drills, and a rank goal that isn't 'trust me bro.'

features.title: VOD reviews that hurt (helpfully)
features.description: Upload a match and get a timestamped breakdown of every misplay, overrotation, and greedy peek — annotated by a coach who's actually hit the rank you want.

features.title: Drills, not vibes
features.description: Skip the 400-tab aim trainer rabbit hole. We assign a weekly routine tuned to your role, your game, and the exact mechanic that's holding your MMR hostage.

features.title: Progress you can screenshot
features.description: Track winrate, KD, and rank over time on one dashboard. When you plateau, your coach gets pinged before you rage-uninstall.

features.title: Tilt triage
features.description: A 10-minute reset protocol for when you're 0-4 and everyone's blaming the jungler. Breathe, requeue, and stop feeding.

features.title: Coaches who queued this week
features.description: Every coach is vetted, currently laddering, and required to prove rank — not a washed streamer coasting on a 2019 highlight reel.

features.title: Any game, one roster
features.description: Val, CS2, League, Apex, Dota, Rocket League. Switch mains without switching platforms or losing your history.

testimonials.quote: I'd been hardstuck Plat for three seasons and blaming my teammates like a functioning adult. My coach found the actual problem in one VOD: me. Diamond in five weeks.
testimonials.name: Mateo Rivas

testimonials.quote: The tilt triage thing sounds like nonsense until you're on a 6-loss streak and it actually works. Requeue with a plan instead of a grudge.
testimonials.name: Priya Nakamura

testimonials.quote: We started routing our academy prospects through Lynx Ladder for off-day reviews. The annotated VODs cut our coaching hours in half.
testimonials.name: Darius Okafor

pricing.blurb: For the grinder who just wants a clear plan and honest feedback.
For prosumers chasing a specific rank on a real timeline.
For the almost-pro treating this like the job it's becoming.

homepage.footerBlurb: Lynx Ladder is coaching for people who are done being hardstuck. No copium, no washed streamers — just the drills, reviews, and honesty that move MMR.
